title: Pond, Not Yet
tagline: Keep the stone up. Water is patient.
concept: Tap at each splash to skip a flat stone across a quiet pond.
core_loop: Launch the stone, watch each short arc, and tap as it meets the water to earn another skip; the changing rhythm makes every five-second crossing feel tense and satisfying.
mechanics: Controls: Tap, click, or press Space to launch, then use the same input at each water contact to skip again.; Win/lose: Reach the far bank to clear a crossing; tap too early or late and the stone sinks, with an instant retry.; Scoring: Gain points for every skip, build a streak with well-timed taps, and earn a clean-cross bonus for reaching shore without a weak bounce.
feedback: A good tap makes a sharp plip, a bright round ripple, and a high clean hop; a weak tap makes a dull splash and a low wobble; a miss sends the stone under with one blunt glug, while a near-miss scrapes the surface and survives with a nervous little bounce.
difficulty: The first crossings use slow, even arcs and wide timing windows; later ponds add shorter hops, alternating high and low arcs, and longer crossings, all shown clearly by the stone’s path and growing contact ripple.
